scope: Executed controlled synthetic workflow; no LLM intermediate states inferred from the saved LoRA experiment.
method: Policy-defined observable checks plus supplied verified replacements and graph re-evaluation. Conditional localization, not proof of a neural cause.

interventions.label: Replace selected figure with reported EPS
Rebuild calculator arguments from checked evidence

source.explanation: Require issuer Harbor Metals and target period 2026 Q2. The supplied exercise document is checked against this declared requirement.

selected.explanation: Select reported EPS, not the forecast figure. Check the selected value and basis against the supplied document fields.

tool_request.explanation: Calculator arguments must equal the selected reported EPS and the supplied consensus EPS.

tool_result.explanation: Independently recompute (actual − consensus) / |consensus|. Correct arithmetic alone does not validate its inputs.

interpretation.explanation: Declared demonstration signal: POSITIVE only when surprise exceeds 10%. This threshold is a teaching rule, not a validated alpha model.

recommendation.explanation: Declared action rule: BUY for POSITIVE, otherwise HOLD. Compare the actual proposal with this rule.

report.explanation: This parallel report depends on source eligibility and figure selection, not on the calculator.

risk.explanation: This parallel flag is supported only if the inputs and calculation pass; it is not a portfolio risk estimate.

authority.explanation: Independent fixed exercise permission: proposed instrument and notional are within the delegated grant.

execution.explanation: Block execution if any required observable check fails. Passing means this declared workflow permits its action, not investment merit.

cases.title: Extraction repair leaves a tool-input failure

source.explanation: Require issuer Harbor Metals and target period 2026 Q2. The supplied exercise document is checked against this declared requirement.

selected.explanation: Select reported EPS, not the forecast figure. Check the selected value and basis against the supplied document fields.

tool_request.explanation: Calculator arguments must equal the selected reported EPS and the supplied consensus EPS.

tool_result.explanation: Independently recompute (actual − consensus) / |consensus|. Correct arithmetic alone does not validate its inputs.

interpretation.explanation: Declared demonstration signal: POSITIVE only when surprise exceeds 10%. This threshold is a teaching rule, not a validated alpha model.

recommendation.explanation: Declared action rule: BUY for POSITIVE, otherwise HOLD. Compare the actual proposal with this rule.
